scope: payload.items on block_number_set, group_create and group_rename, and the batched block and type kinds in a namespace: scripts/qualify_change_batch.py on a Debug build of 48bf67a8, 129/129 steps (run cb_0cd7d0ae) in one owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN. Repeats every step of local.change-batch.items.20261111 (batches of tag_set, tag_create, constant_create, constant_set, constant_delete, tag_delete, tag_table_create, tag_table_rename, block_rename, block_attributes_set and type_rename, the tag kinds in a software unit, their refusals, and a type_rename batch that fails natively at its second item, ends recovery_required and is restored). New: a block_number_set batch numbers two FCs 741 and 742 under one checkpoint, compile and save and both read back; one number for two blocks of one kind refuses with BlockNumberCollision naming both items, a number another item frees refuses at that item, one block in two items refuses. For block, type and tag-table groups each: a group_create batch creates two groups, a second creates a group of one name in each, a group_rename batch renames the two outer groups and another renames the two inner groups to one name under their two parents; all paths read back. On block groups, refused and unchanged: one name twice under one parent (ObjectExists), a group under a group the same batch creates (GroupNotFound at that item), a group inside a group another item renames (InvalidRequest naming both items), two siblings renamed to one name, one group in two items. Namespaces: a second software unit holds block NbSame and data type NySame once in namespace BatchNs and once in none, seeded by SCL sources with and without a NAMESPACE envelope. block_rename, block_attributes_set and type_rename batches select each object with namespace beside the name; one batch renames NbSame in both namespaces to NbSame_R and one renames NySame in both to NySame_R, and software_inspect places every object in its namespace afterwards. Refused and unchanged: a name two namespaces hold given without namespace (AmbiguousTarget at that item), one namespaced block in two items, one new name twice in one namespace, a name the namespace already holds. block_number_set on a block of that unit, in the namespace and outside it, refuses at preparation with AttributeNotWritable for AutoNumber.
limitations: One owned scratch standard CPU: PLC-root scope, one software unit (tag kinds) and one software unit with one namespace (block and type kinds, FCs and one struct type). Tag kinds are not exercised in the namespace unit; tags have no namespace.

block_number_set is applied on two FCs at PLC-root scope. In the software unit TIA reported AutoNumber as not writable on its FCs, so no number was set there; other block kinds and other units are not exercised.
Group refusals are exercised on block groups; type and tag-table groups run the applied batches only. The cross-item rules are the same code for all three and are covered by managed tests.
The batch that fails after its first write is a type_rename; the tag_table_rename and tag_create candidates with a double quote in a name were accepted by TIA and applied.

The safety-tag and F-I/O refusals of a batch are in local.safety.tag-batch.20261111 and local.safety.fio-routes.20261111. Each batch has two or three items; the 100-item bound is covered by managed tests only.

The source commit changes only scripts/qualify_safety_drive_tags.py after the built 48bf67a8; src, this runner and every executable run are byte-identical to it. Engineering only; runtime behavior is not observed.
